chunks: From him, from Salih, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Aban ibn Uthman, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Indeed, for Iblees there is a helper called Tamreeh. When the night comes, he fills what is between the two horizons.
ai.seo_question: Who is Tamreeh and what does he do when night falls?
ai.summary: In this narration from al-Kafi, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) identifies 'Tamreeh' as a specific auxiliary of Iblees who expands to fill the space between the two horizons at night, symbolizing the pervasive reach of evil forces during darkness. This imagery reflects the Shia scholarly understanding of how spiritual distractions and temptations intensify when the physical world is veiled by night, serving as a reminder for believers to maintain vigilance.

en.hubeali: H 14752 – From him, from Salih, from Ali Bin Al-Hakam, from Abaan Bin Usman, who has said: Abu Abdullahasws has said:
‘Iblees<sup>la</sup> has a helper called ‘تَمْرِيحٌ’ Tamreeh. When the night comes, he fills what is between the two palpitations (of the heart)’.
en.sarwar: 304. From him, from Salih, from Ali Bin Al-Hakam, from Abaan Bin Usman, who has said: Abu Abdullah (a.s.) has said:
